R4 JUDGEMENT (mine, not inherited): I AGREE WITH THE CRITIC. R4 reads "Interiors get their own bed, not the exterior bed at -12 dB." The main clause is positive and imperative - interiors GET a bed; the subordinate clause forbids one particular wrong bed. R1s null permission is explicitly per-LAYER inside a declared bed ("Every region declares all four layers, and a layer may be declared null"), not a licence for a whole cell to have no bed. The ARBITRATION note about silence being a design statement is scoped to a REGION ("silence in a dry region") and cites R1, i.e. layers. And RI-WLD08 §6 independently mandates ">=13 (one per region) + >=8 settlement beds + >=4 interior beds" - a positive count that silence cannot satisfy. Round 1s "interiors go silent and report suppressed" is therefore not permitted by the item. Building interior beds.

THE CRITICS OWN PROBE IS THE RIGHT ACCEPTANCE INSTRUMENT: tools/analysis/critic-w1-22-probe.mjs section B already does perturb/observe/restore on bell_buoy +40 dB across four paths (offline no-listener, control L1, offline with listener, LIVE attach+stepFrames+render) and prints the L1 control. I will re-run it UNCHANGED after the fix. Builder does not grade itself; a red->green on an instrument I did not write is the strongest evidence available to me.

DONE (1/n): synth.js attachMod scaling fixed via new buildContinuous(...,gainMul) arg; ambience.js buildBedContinuous folds level_db*trim IN rather than multiplying after. Verdict §2 three-line remedy.

DONE (2/n): emitters now CONSUME. AmbienceDriver.step() gives strike emitters their own shared LayerClock (new emitterClock(), degenerate [period,period] band + declared phase), schedules buildGrain into the live bus, and writes ambience_emitter rows (pan/gain/gain_db/distance_m/bearing_deg/sounded). Placement rows are emitted on CHANGE (pan >=0.01 or gain >=0.5 dB) so B6s 200 m transect has dense rows without a standing probe writing 4000 identical ones.

SECOND DEFECT THE VERDICT DID NOT CATCH, found while fixing the first: the clay-moor kiln has synth.kind "noise" (brown noise + lowpass + gain LFO) and the ONLY code path that could ever have sounded an emitter was buildGrain(), which given no source:"noise" and no partials_hz falls through to [s.freq_hz || 440] and renders an industrial roar as a 440 Hz SINE BLIP. Fixing the silence without fixing this would have shipped the blip. Emitters now have two modes: emitterMode(e) returns continuous for kind noise/drone (kiln) and strike otherwise. Continuous emitters get buildEmitterVoices() - source -> level/trim -> rolloff gain -> panner -> bus - built once on region swap, with the driver writing rolloff.gain and panner.pan every frame from emitterPlacement(). That is the kiln you steer by, and it is §Bs own words: Clay Moor L2 is "kiln roar (proximity-driven)".

THIRD FINDING, and it reverses a round-1 decision: §C REQUIRES the emitters in the blind clip. Round 1s renderBedOffline comment said "null listener = the region bed alone, which is what §Cs blind clip wants: no landmarks". §C says the opposite - its key note reads "those four are separated by Q3 instead (bell buoy / hide-drum / oars / lichen-scream), which is why R7s positional emitters and each regions signature L3 are load-bearing rather than decorative". A clip with no bell cannot separate Marauders Coast. ambienceCapture() now places the listener at the player by DEFAULT; listener:null still gives the landmark-free bed but must be asked for.

FOURTH FINDING, a defect in RI-AUD03 §C itself: the item asserts "the key has no duplicate triples except (wet, open, living), shared by four coastal/rootland regions". FALSE. (dry, open, living) is ALSO shared - by The Salt Hills and The Clay Moor. So a fifth region pair depends on Q3 separation (legion horn vs kiln) and the item does not say so. Worth an amendment.
